APIS India Limited engages in testing, processing, and filtration of honey in India. The company provides honey, such as acacia, eucalyptus, himalaya honey, lychee, sunflower and wild flower forest, lemon infused, ginger honey, and chilly honey under the APIS Himalaya brand name; green tea; lime, mango tang, mixed veggies, and tomato; preserves; masala dates; mouth freshener; dates, such as premium seeded, royal zahidi, arabian pearls, shahana, deseeded, nayaab, desert bliss, classic, kalmi, [...] classic, kalmi, and select dates; fruitilicious jam; soya chunks; corn flakes; choco flakes; ginger garlic paste; thin roasted seviyan vermicelli; saffron; peanut butter; and organic honey under the Apis brand. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as eWeb Univ Limited. APIS India Limited was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
